wait.done: All of today's passes are done.
wait.disabled: Automatic cleaning is off for this room.
wait.action_error: The custom clean action is not valid: fix it in the room settings.
wait.awake: Waiting for someone to be up.
wait.ready: Free and due: the robot starts shortly.
wait.proxy: Waiting for someone in another room
wait.robot_paused: The robot did not start: trying again at {time}.
wait.robot_busy: Free and due: the robot is busy.
robot.paused: Automatic cleaning is paused: rooms are cleaned only with the buttons.
robot.all_done: All rooms are done for today
robot.nothing_planned: No room can be cleaned today any more
overview.estimate_note: Times are estimates: they change with presence.
overview.no_rooms: No rooms yet. Add the rooms the robot should clean, with their presence sensors and daily targets.
rooms.intro: The order is the priority when several rooms could be cleaned at the same time. Each room needs a Home Assistant area mapped to the robot's map.
rooms.proxy: free while someone is in {n} other sensor(s)
rooms.targets: {full} vacuum and mop + {vacuum} vacuum a day
editor.not_found: This room does not exist any more.
editor.form_unavailable: The form could not be loaded. Reload the page.
editor.area_hint: The area must be mapped to a room of the robot's map: vacuum entity settings, "Areas".
editor.advanced_hint: Only for robots whose integration rejects area cleaning: these actions replace it. Work mode and fan speed are still set first. Variables: room, area_id, kind (full or vacuum), quiet, vacuum_entity.
settings.hint_schedule: No cleaning during quiet hours, not even after a deadline. The robot starts only with enough battery.
settings.hint_wake: On the chosen days, cleaning starts only after someone has been detected for a while, for example in the kitchen at breakfast.
settings.hint_robot: How Tidy Rooms drives the robot: work mode for each kind of pass and fan speeds.
settings.hint_signals: How Tidy Rooms knows that a job is over. Best: a sensor of the robot that is on for the whole job.
settings.robot_no_options: The robot reports no fan speeds.
confirm.clean_text: The robot starts right away, even if someone is in the room, and the pass counts towards today's targets.
confirm.stop_text: The robot goes back to the dock and {room} stays due.
confirm.delete_text: The room, its entities and its saved progress are removed. The job history is kept.
error.robot_busy: The robot is already busy with a job.
error.area_already_configured: This area already has a room.
error.proxy_with_occupancy: Use either the room's own sensors or the sensors of other rooms, not both.
error.vacuum_less_than_full: Vacuum passes include the vacuum and mop passes: they cannot be fewer.
field.full_per_day: Vacuum and mop passes per day
field.wake_minutes: Minutes of presence to count as awake
field.full_mode_option: Work mode for vacuum and mop
field.start_timeout: Minutes to wait for the robot to start before retrying
field.job_done_delay: Minutes docked before a job counts as done
help.occupancy_sensors: The room is cleaned after all of them have reported nobody for the minutes below.
help.proxy_sensors: For rooms without their own sensor: the room counts as free while one of these sensors detects someone elsewhere.
help.vacuum_per_day: A vacuum and mop pass counts as a vacuum pass too.
help.min_gap_hours: Between two passes of the same room.
help.full_deadline: After this time the room is cleaned even if someone is there, with the quiet fan speed. Leave empty to never force it.
help.vacuum_deadline: As above, for the vacuum passes.
help.wake_sensors: Leave empty to skip the check.
help.work_mode_entity: A select entity of the robot that switches between vacuum only and vacuum and mop.
help.quiet_fan_speed: Used only when a room is cleaned after its deadline while someone is there.
help.battery_entity: For robots that report the battery in a separate sensor.
help.job_entity: On from the start to the end of a job, also while the robot is at the dock in the middle of it. A job started elsewhere (app, schedule) keeps the robot busy.
help.finished_event: Event types finished and finished_with_warnings end the job right away; other types mark it as stopped.
help.job_done_delay: Used only without a cleaning job sensor. A return to recharge also counts as the end.
